reason: Post-result audit found that W-R15/W-R16 training jitter ((3*t+e+seed)%3)-1 was constant across ticks. This is a fresh distinct experiment, NOT replay or repair of the consumed evaluations.
hypothesis: When development positives contain genuine varying per-tick nuisance, a development-only scalar separation threshold may recognize genuine temporal order on unseen stronger jitter where a fixed perceptron is brittle.
freeze: Commit exact nondegenerate jitter formula, fresh seeds, arms, threshold method and all classifications before first original execution. No adjustment, relabeling, or replay after outcome.
generator: Frozen W-R11 16-tick 4-channel synthetic sequence, 9 entities/seed; apply candidate global +17 in development and +61 heldout. Jitter all four channels at each tick with train ((5*t+e+seed)%3)-1, heldout ((7*t+e+seed)%5)-2; assert each tick series has respectively 3 and 5 distinct jitter levels.
labels: Positive preserves temporal order after shift+jitter. Negative permutes only candidate tail (reverse for even entity and rotate left 3 for odd entity in development; even/odd weave in heldout). Both labels share identical candidate first row and unordered row multiset.
arms: 16-feature unordered relative histogram trained with fixed perceptron
16 copies of pooled anchor-relative circular mismatch trained with same perceptron
one scalar threshold trained only from development maximum positive and minimum negative pooled score (midpoint), even if distributions overlap
learning: 16 weights+bias 32 epochs learning rate0.1 for each perceptron; scalar threshold one train-only parameter. No heldout score/calibration access.
metrics: Per heldout seed TP,TN,FP,FN, balanced accuracy and precise development positive/negative score range. ROBUST_TRANSFER if threshold>=0.85 and unordered<=0.55, PARTIAL if threshold beats comparators, NEGATIVE otherwise; also flag invalid generator if noise cardinality asserts fail.
validity: Frozen original source identity and prior W-R11 generator, per-tick jitter nondegeneracy, independent cohort, determinism, first-use artifact, one full Wingless regression.
claim_limit: Synthetic controlled temporal feature learning only, not natural language cognition; no accepted-ref mutation.
